concept.title: VPN software guide
concept.shortdesc: This guide talks about VPN software.

conbody.p: This guide helps you get started with the VPN software. VPN stands for Virtual Private Network. It keeps data safe when you work outside the office in cafes, airports and homes and use it. Public WiFi can lead to data theft by hackers. They can access system software like Outlook, file drives and Intranet web pages.
